content: Theobromos is the scientific term for chocolate as referenced in the science fiction series The Company by Kage Baker. The effects of Theobromos on immortals are distinct from the effects of theobromine on humans. In the novels, Theobromos has the ability to elevate mood and produce other emotional effects in immortals. When consumed in excessive amounts, Theobromos causes symptoms akin to alcohol intoxication, including disorientation, impaired balance, and heightened emotional expressiveness. Overindulgence also leads to a hangover-like state the following day, characterized by severe headaches, skin irritation, and an intense feeling of hunger. Theobromos is most commonly consumed orally, either in the form of chocolate or as hot chocolate. Additionally, powdered cocoa can be insufflated nasally, in a manner similar to the recreational use of cocaine.
